voice.name: Arthur Blackwood
voice.pitch_and_speed: Natural; no pitch shifting or time stretching
voice.production: Independent complete theatrical phrases, preserving each generated word ending and a quiet tail

narration.text: Ho, ho, ho! Good evening, everyone. Father Christmas here, with a little Christmas magic.
Wake up, little bushes! One by one. Such lovely Christmas colours.
And now the windows. Every little pane gets its own moment to shine. Round we go, nice and gently.
Christmas tree, show us your sparkle!
And icicles, a little winter magic.
Ah, splendid! All the Christmas colours, together.
Hang on! Is that cheeky elf trying to borrow the car?
Those headlights have spotted him! No driving tonight, little fellow.
He's through the front door! There he goes. One room, then another.
After him, fairy lights! He's two rooms ahead. Follow that golden glow!
Nearly! Oh, he's doubled back. What a mischievous elf.
There he goes again. Through the bar, into the office, and up to the landing.
Here come the fairy lights. Room by room. They're following his trail.
Into the bedroom! Back to the landing. Oh, now he's sneaking into the office!
Keep going, fairy lights. He's just two rooms ahead of you!
Shh. Where has he hidden?
A little Christmas magic...
There you are! Caught you! Ho, ho, ho! Well done, fairy lights.
Now, the big finale! All together, count us in!
Five.
Four.
Three.
Two.
One!
Oh, wonderful!
Ooh, look at that!
What a sparkle!
Ah! Another surprise!
Oh, that's beautiful.
Ho, ho, ho! Marvellous!
From all of us at the North Pole, have a wonderful Christmas. Good night, everyone. And you, little elf... leave that car alone! Ho, ho, ho!
